reuse.why: Changes only the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate that every holiday-aware path (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, server handlers) already calls.

duplication.why: The holiday match is defined once in a small private helper; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The matching lives in shared/schedules.ts next to isWeekendOrHoliday.

scope.why: One helper, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, commented and the single point where the holiday format is interpreted.
